assessment: The paper is of broad interest to readers focusing on quality control functions of autophagy contributing towards neuronal health. This work provides substantial new insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying the dynamic nature of the quality control function of autophagy. Building on their previous work, in the current advance the authors identify phosphatase as crucial for controlling a phospho-switch which counteracts a kinase complex dependent phosphorylation. The authors demonstrated this phospho-switch as a key integrator of multiple stress signals including. Overall the findings are interesting and important.
